title: LaB Media
description: A small film studio and a public notebook, run out of Shelby Township, Michigan.

items.title: Detroit New Wave: The Rise of Cinema Culture
items.content_text: A live-recorded panel bringing Metro Detroit’s independent cinema owners, audiences, and filmmakers into the same room — at least three theaters and microcinemas per night, followed by a social hour with food and drinks. If you want to actually meet the people programming film in this city, this is the room. — The Congregation, Detroit

items.title: Adam & Eva’s: An Intimate Film Experience
items.content_text: A live projection of A Man Called Adam — Sammy Davis Jr., from The Black Canon collection — paired with curated music and signature drinks built around the film. Designed as more than a screening: an evening staged inside the mood and sound of the picture, celebrating Black film history and legacy. — Miss Eva’s, Detroit
